description: As a memory forensics analyst, detect_etw_tampering surfaces ETW provider abuse patterns so I can identify process injection, provider disabling, and event dropping in memory dumps
steps: detect_etw_tampering flags a session with events_lost > 1000 as HighEventsLost
detect_etw_tampering flags a session with log_mode = 0 (no output configured) as SuspiciousLogMode
detect_etw_tampering returns empty vec for a normal active session with low events_lost and standard log_mode
MemoryRecoveredChunk implements serde::Serialize so it can be included in JSON triage output
